note: Established the premise from the record rather than the mandate: three consecutive adversarial passes on scripts/pro/pro-git-pull.sh (#5492 refuter, #5496 gate) each found a shape nobody asked about, and each cure was wrong about a neighbouring one. Read both PRs' real diffs and the resolver's actual branches before writing a line. Conclusion: the surface is under-specified, so the builder contract's depth-1 rule prescribes a spec, not a third patch.

Enumerator + reviewed baseline + spec. 102 constructible cells of 8 states x 7 actions x 2 policies = 112; 7 measured fields per cell; the 8th column (verdict) is human-written and the comparison never touches it, so the machine cannot overwrite the judgement.

matrix-refuter, fresh context, grading a diff it did not author. Found the instrument CONTENT-BLIND: the ls-tree probes asserted an object's silhouette (presence/type) and not its identity, so a fixture built with wrong content satisfied the assertion. Three faces of one defect.

One cure for all three faces rather than three patches: assert mode+type+blob SHA against hashes derived from the fixture constants via git hash-object, plus a recursive blob count under the path. Slice replacement initially DUPLICATED 76 lines and `bash -n` passed it -- caught only because all 5 sabotages then reported CAUGHT on the SAME cell. Restored and redone scoped to the function.

fix-verifier, independent, on fresh context: constructed a genuine engineered collision -- a REGULAR FILE whose bytes are exactly the symlink target string -- and confirmed the SHA assertion catches it where the silhouette assertion could not. Innocence run green at 102/102.

fs-scope-refuter: the CI red was not a flake. The rename_case_only axis measures a defect that exists ONLY where the filesystem folds case, and ubuntu is case-sensitive -- the cells still ran but measured a different phenomenon. Also proved macos-latest was already available in-repo, closing the coverage gap I had deferred.

Filesystem promoted from assumption to declared COORDINATE: three-outcome probe (folds / does not fold / unprobeable-FATAL-exit-3), axis held out with the held-out count printed inline, --write-baseline REFUSES from a partial run. Proved on a real case-folding volume AND a real case-sensitive one. macOS leg added with a gate that exit 1s if the runner does not fold case, so a green run there cannot mean 88 cells measured quietly.

verdict-auditor -- the first grading of the HUMAN half of this instrument. Found TWO FALSE `OK` verdicts (resolver crash is not fail-safe), two over-harsh KNOWN_BADs, and reasons misattributed on four more rows. None of it visible to the machine: the 7 measured fields were correct throughout and never moved.

Verdicts corrected (50 OK / 52 KNOWN_BAD, from 54/48) and the guard extended to the OPTIMISTIC side: an unargued KNOWN_BAD is merely pessimistic, an unargued OK is a defect blessed in writing. The guard now demands a reason wherever OK is a CLAIM rather than an observation.

I REFUTED A CORRECT FINDING WITH A PROBE OF THE WRONG SHAPE. `cp -p` onto a dangling symlink exits 1 when the target has a missing intermediate directory, and exits 0 while FOLLOWING the link when the target is a bare filename with an existing parent. I probed the first; the fixture commits the second. The wrong mechanism reached the baseline, the doc and a report to the owner before being corrected in all three. Recorded because the report was already sent.

cell-reproducer, 22 cells reproduced individually. The reason text on 28 rows named a mechanism that does not fire, in two OPPOSITE ways: on 16 non-rename rows of dangling_symlink/dir_at_path the tracked branch RUNS and crashes inside cp -p (signature: backup dir created and EMPTY); on the 12 rename rows the resolver never runs at all. A cure aimed at the reason as written would have landed in two empty places.

Authoring this pack, re-derived the axis arithmetic from the baseline instead of from the document and found the document wrong: the A axis listed seven local states and omitted `symlink`, which has a 12-cell row in its own register table, and the totals said 88 of 98 where the truth is 102 of 112. The stale 88 was the dangerous half -- it is ALSO the case-sensitive measured count, so the document carried two unrelated 88s. Fixed in 644a9fe0d2.

Cross-family, effort high, read-only, on the real diff. FOUR findings with file:line. (1) THE CASE-ONLY keeplocal FIXTURE DOES NOT CONSTRUCT keeplocal: the allowlist is written with the ORIGINAL spelling (spec_collision_matrix.sh:309 writes "$P" = Subject.md) while the incoming path is subject.md, and the resolver matches with `grep -qxF` (pro-git-pull.sh:199) which is whole-line and byte-literal — so all 7 rename_case_only keeplocal cells exercise the ORDINARY policy under a keeplocal label. VERIFIED by the conductor at both named lines. (2) The enumerator cannot observe the symlink defect it registers: backup classification collapses regular files and preserved symlinks into backup=file, so curing `cp -p` to preserve the link would move NO measured field and the comparator would still print MATRIX STABLE. (3) Final-state measurement is lossy on the flagship axis: exact directory-entry spelling makes a live lowercase subject.md read `absent` on a folding volume, and regular files are sampled on only 14 bytes, so wrong content past byte 14 passes. (4) The macOS job is allocated unconditionally — step-level `if:` can skip the matrix but cannot stop a 10x-billed runner from starting. Finding 4 was reached INDEPENDENTLY by the Gear-3 gate.

THREE attempts, three NON-JUDGEMENTS, and the shape matters more than the count. Full prompt 115,902B: client-side timeout at 600.2s, HTTP status None. Reduced 39,774B: ConnectionResetError [Errno 54] after 431.8s — the gateway dropped the connection, not a timeout. Minimal 32,872B: timeout again at 600.1s. The seat is verifiably LIVE and fast in isolation (PONG probe HTTP 200 in 2.2s), and the credential path is the repo's own load_tp1_settings_key/http_post_json, so this is neither a dead seat nor a dispatch failure: it is a structural capacity limit of this TP1/DashScope endpoint for an adversarial-review-scale prompt, independent of size within 32-115KB — 32.8KB failed the same way as 115KB. No reasoning_effort knob exists in the repo's TP1 call path, so capping its thinking budget could not be tested. CORRECTED 2026-09-02: an earlier version of this entry said 'two attempts, HTTP 200 both times with content length 0'. That was inferred from the response FILES rather than measured from the calls, and was wrong on all three counts — attempts, status, and failure mode.

Independent verification of codex's BLOCK, by execution against a scratch puller (--puller is honoured at a single invocation site, L319, for all 102 cells — checked, so both probes measured what they claim). FINDING 2 REFUTED: cp -p -> cp -Pp at L196 moved 12 cells (MATRIX MOVED), all and only A in {symlink, dangling_symlink}; the coherent three-site cure moved 10. rc, moved and outcome all move, so the predicted 'MATRIX STABLE, zero CI signal' does not occur. The literal reading of L337 holds (backed= folds file and preserved-symlink together via `find -type f -o -type l`) but its consequence is empirically false. FINDING 3a CONFIRMED: a real cell run end-to-end leaves Subject.md readable and `[ -e ]`-true while the exact-spelling `ls | grep -Fx` at L326 reports absent — so outcome=absent is OVERLOADED between 'genuinely gone' and 'renamed-but-recoverable', and a future content-loss regression on one of those cells would print what a benign case-rename already prints. Bounded to the one axis, and already narrated in all 14 rename_case_only reasons, so surfaced-and-judged rather than hidden. FINDING 3b CONFIRMED: outcome= samples 14 bytes (L330); a file corrupted from byte 15 on, sharing the 'ORIGIN-V2 body' prefix, is indistinguishable. This is the SAME defect class cured on the origin side this morning (assert the object, not its silhouette) left standing on the RESULT side.

Three of codex's four findings cured in the instrument, one refuted, one ledgered. outcome= now carries the blob hash (was a 14-byte sample); absent/case-renamed split with the hash on BOTH branches — the first version of that split reported only the new NAME, which replaced one silhouette with another, and was caught by re-reading it; backed= distinguishes symlink from file. THE CURE PAID IMMEDIATELY: 30 cells moved measurement, 16 only by gaining the hash (verdicts carried by coordinate, and the hash CONFIRMED the readable prefix was truthful), 14 changed semantically. Of those, FOUR moved OK -> KNOWN_BAD with the puller UNCHANGED — the instrument simply became able to see them. Register 50/52 -> 46/56. Every one of the 14 was judged from a measurement, never inferred: two independent sub-sessions reproduced the cells end to end and one of them arrived at the same adjudication standard and the same mechanism paragraph independently.

Two independent reproductions of the case-only axis. First: on modified x rename_case_only x keeplocal, `grep -rl PRO-LOCAL-EDIT` after the pull matches ONLY the timestamped backup, never the worktree under either spelling; the live path holds origin's base blob. Root cause pinned with a raw git probe and confirmed invariant under three allowlist spellings. Second: dir_at_path loses a whole DIRECTORY and its payload to the backup (found at $BACKUP/<ts>/subject.md/inner) while rc=0 is reported; dangling_symlink loses the link, which survives in the backup AS A LINK because the untracked branch uses `mv` and does not dereference — unlike the tracked branch's `cp -p`, which is why backed= needed splitting. For both pairs the keeplocal and ordinary variants are byte-identical on worktree, backup and log: the allowlist has zero observable effect on this axis.

THE SEAT JUDGES — the earlier NON-JUDGEMENT entry above is not retracted, it is BOUNDED. Its conclusion 'size-independent in that range, so a shorter prompt does not rescue it' was a wrong inference from a range whose FLOOR was 32,872B: nothing below that had ever been sent. A 3,436-byte prompt — an order of magnitude under that floor, carrying the finding, the mechanism, the author's own scope limit and the decision, and demanding a fixed final verdict line — returned 494 bytes in under 7 minutes, exit 0. Four reasoned verdicts, all AGREE, and 'VERDICT: PASS'. Q1 (mechanism): identical outcomes across all three allowlist variants fit an unreachable branch better than a spelling bug. Q2 (scope): the hash only exposes the surviving blob, so it cannot mechanically distinguish the clean cell from the loss cells — it endorsed the NARROWER claim, not the stronger one. Q3 carries the sharpest caveat and it is ACCEPTED, not argued away: the revert pair proves the suffix is caused by the three cure lines, NOT that the baseline's verdicts are independently right — those rest on the A coordinate and on judgment, and this pack does not claim otherwise. Q4 (do not arm the required check yet): non-blocking use keeps the known-defect signal visible without making it a misleading merge gate. With this entry the R9 quorum is met by two DISTINCT cross-family seats, codex-gpt-5.6-sol and tp1-qwen3.8-max, and neither is same-family with the author.
